name: r4_harvest_lots
how: Oracle segmentation: seeds located with the hwdtghttp7 dataset masks (not human-verified), so only classification error is measured. Crushed vs intact, impurity excluded. FrozenLogReg (DINOv2-small frozen features of masked crops, balanced weights) trained on 28 train originals (augs 01/06/10); C in [0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0] and P(crushed) threshold in 0.05..0.95 picked on 6 val originals (aug 01) by crushed F1 (C=0.3, thr=0.79); val Se/Sp at that threshold feed Rogan-Gladen. 6 test originals (aug 01) scored once. Per lot: true % = crushed/(crushed+intact) over the classified crops; raw % = predicted crushed / seeds; Wilson 95 % on raw; corrected interval two ways: RG applied to the Wilson endpoints (sampling only, Se/Sp treated as known) and a parametric bootstrap redrawing the lot count and val Se/Sp binomially (2000 draws). MAE CI: bootstrap over lots. Per-seed F1 CI: grouped bootstrap over originals. Decision demo at an illustrative 5 % threshold; seeds needed = smallest n at which the RG-transformed Wilson interval at the same observed rate excludes the threshold. LOO-40 is a separate protocol.
code_rev: unknown (box copy is not a git checkout)

selection.criterion: max crushed F1 on val originals (aug 01)

per_seed_f1_crushed_valtest12_secondary.note: val originals were used to pick C and threshold, so this view is optimistic

loo40_different_protocol.protocol: train on aug-01 crops of the other 39 originals, C and threshold fixed from the main protocol (picked on the 6 val originals, slight leakage for those 6), RG with main val Se/Sp
